Welcome! Glad you're joining me for this journey—because we’re about to explore something most of us rarely talk about, but everyone feels at some point: how our own habits can quietly get in the way of our next big breakthrough.
You know, it’s funny. The very things that once made us successful can start working against us as we aim higher. The climb from being good at what you do to truly excelling as a leader or as a person? It’s rarely straightforward. There are subtle behaviors—sometimes even the ones we’re most proud of—that can sneak up and limit our growth, especially when we’re not paying attention.
That’s what Marshall Goldsmith digs deep into in his book, What Got You Here Won't Get You There. He shines a light on the paradox of success—how our strengths can morph into hurdles when we’re ready for the next level. Instead of focusing on technical know-how or just pushing harder, Goldsmith invites us to rethink how we connect with others, tune into our own blind spots, and open ourselves up to meaningful change.
So, what are we going to discover together? We’ll talk about why the shift from competence to excellence means looking closely at our habits, especially those that affect our relationships and influence. We’ll uncover ways to spot those invisible barriers, and I’ll share some practical strategies to help you break through your own limits—no matter where you are in your journey.
Get ready for real-world stories, honest self-reflection, and ideas you can use right away. Because this isn’t just about adding more skills to your toolbox—it’s about letting go of the old patterns that have outlived their usefulness. And that’s how we set the stage for real, lasting growth—together.
